name: GHCL Textiles Ltd
title: GHCL Textiles Ltd - 543918 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Yarn spreads rose to INR148/kg in Q4 from INR123 in Q3 and management expects Q1 FY27 to hold, but 120 days of cotton inventory and a 15-18% EBITDA margin target by FY29-30 leave execution and working-capital risk.

utilisation.quote: In Q4, we achieved 98% plus utilization.

capex.quote: FY27 capex plan will be between INR100 crores, INR120 crores.

triggers.label: Spread INR123 → INR148/kg Q3 to Q4
triggers.quote: our spread in Q3 was about INR123 per kilo, which has gone up to about INR148 kilo in Q4

triggers.label: Utilisation 98%+ in Q4
triggers.quote: In Q4, we achieved 98% plus utilization.

triggers.label: Cotton inventory ~120 days
triggers.quote: We have approximately around 120 days of inventory as on 31st of March.

triggers.label: Revenue INR2,000 cr by FY29-30
triggers.quote: we are sort of aiming for FY29 at least for the top line, maybe around FY30

guidance.quote: if we continue to maintain that definitely 15% to 18% margin is a within the next 3 years.
We are holding on to that.
FY27 capex plan will be between INR100 crores, INR120 crores.
we are adhering to our policy of 8% to 12% payout.
what spreads we have received in quarter 4, at least it seems to continue in quarter 1

red_flags.label: Receivables up 43%; payment discipline weak
red_flags.quote: payment discipline was not there. And in certain cases, higher credit limit was extended.

red_flags.label: Working capital elevated on cotton build
red_flags.quote: we are at an elevated working capital level primarily because we pre-empted a lot of these cotton price increases

red_flags.label: China yarn demand tapering since March
red_flags.quote: we have seen a tapering down on demand since March

evasions.topic: Gross margin mismatch with spread increase
evasions.quote: I am not able to understand why you are saying there is improvement in gross margin?
I don't have the exact percentage number
